do_not_use_when: No store exists yet: this operation reads a completed amplitude store and does not produce one.

examples.phrase: Reweight a stored amplitude set into binned predictions for a new coupling point.

use_when: Turn a stored Gram store into binned predictions for any coupling, mass, width or propagator choice without regenerating points.
